findings.title: Ops-1 bare-metal claim not re-proven at freeze SHA
findings.observation: Dockerfile (node:22-alpine multi-stage) and deploy/*.sh (setup, bot, backup, smoke, update) exist on main, but Step 3 did not execute bare-metal install/smoke against freeze SHA. Issue #73 Ops-1 is [x] historically only.
findings.impact: Cannot promote stage 2 to VERIFIED; Ops completeness deferred to stages 46-52/66.
findings.fixNeed: Run documented bare-metal/docker smoke on freeze SHA and attach logs; or accept PARTIAL until deploy stage.
findings.regressionTestNeed: Optional deploy smoke gate in CI with pinned script checksums.

findings.title: Mobile touch CSS exists but full authenticated mobile matrix incomplete
findings.observation: index.css/theme.css enforce min 44px on coarse pointer; stage-23 inventory reports mobile verified=28, partial=1, shell-only=28. Issue #73 HOCH Desktop+320-430 authenticated matrix remains unchecked.
findings.impact: Stage 6 cannot be VERIFIED; dashboard 23-26 cannot claim full mobile product proof.
findings.fixNeed: Authenticated E2E mobile matrix for remaining shell-only surfaces; update inventory mobile statuses.
findings.regressionTestNeed: Playwright authenticated mobile suites beyond architecture gates.

findings.title: Live-server knowledge index failure is warn-only after mirror snapshot
findings.observation: snapshotService calls indexNitradoSnapshotKnowledge in try/catch and only logs warn on failure; mirror still succeeds. Couples with AI background best-effort posture (F-S2-04).
findings.impact: Operators may believe LIVE_SERVER knowledge is fresh when indexing silently failed.
findings.fixNeed: Surface index failure to metrics/alerts and/or snapshot status field; optional fail-closed policy for LIVE knowledge freshness.
findings.regressionTestNeed: Integration test asserting metric/audit when index throws after OK snapshot.

findings.title: AI-18 tool layer not production-wired (Issue #73 overclaim)
findings.observation: AiToolExecutor/register/execute and AiToolStepUpService exist with strong unit tests, but no production importer registers tools or invokes executor. Confirms F-S2-01. Issue #73 AI-18 is [x].
findings.impact: Stage 20 FAILED. Claimed hardened tool side-effect path is library-only.
evidence: grep: no prod AiToolExecutor usage outside toolLayer
findings.fixNeed: Wire executor into AI runtime with explicit tool catalog OR reopen #73 AI-18 and document out-of-scope until wired.
findings.regressionTestNeed: Architecture gate: fail if toolLayer exports unused and #73 claims ready; or integration test that production bootstrap registers >=1 tool.

findings.title: Golden DayZ eval is offline unit suite, not live LLM E2E
findings.observation: runGoldenDayzEvaluation exercises boundary/validation/preflight/answer-validation cases without calling providers. Acceptable for regression gate; does not prove live model quality.
findings.impact: No status demotion if contract is offline gate; do not market as live benchmark.
findings.fixNeed: None for VERIFIED offline contract; optional separate live eval stage later.

findings.title: Dashboard matrix docs pinned to stale SHAs vs freeze 48bbcffa
findings.observation: surface inventory inventoriedMainSha=b98e2cf...; button matrix inventoriedMainSha=3daf103...; crud basedOnMainSha=d71b21e... and architecture test hard-expects that SHA. Freeze HEAD is 48bbcfface38068bc71ad7bcc5c1dd87616da514.
findings.impact: Matrix docs/tests prove historical inventory consistency, not current HEAD surface completeness. PARTIAL for 23/24/26.
findings.fixNeed: Re-inventory at freeze SHA; update docs SHAs; relax hard-pin to freeze-aware check or regenerate in CI.
findings.regressionTestNeed: Gate: inventoriedMainSha must equal process env FREEZE_SHA or current HEAD.

findings.title: Stage 23 inventory self-reports large partial/shell-only debt
findings.observation: 57 surfaces: tests verified=28 partial=29; mobile verified=28 shell-only=28 partial=1. Architecture gate only ensures inventory shape + App route id set, not product E2E green for each surface.
findings.impact: Cannot VERIFIED stage 23 despite #73 [x] and PR #194 claims.
findings.fixNeed: Close partial/shell-only via authenticated E2E (stages 27-35) then refresh inventory statuses at freeze SHA.

findings.title: Dashboard button/switch/CRUD proofs are architecture/static, not mutation E2E
findings.observation: Gates walk App.tsx import graph / AST / JSON contracts. Issue #73 leaves Dashboard buttons/switches/CRUD and authenticated action matrices unchecked. Aligns with F-PRE-06.
findings.impact: Stages 24-26 PARTIAL; product AuthZ/IDOR/race proof deferred to 27-38.
findings.fixNeed: Authenticated action matrices with fail-closed negative cases (later steps).
findings.regressionTestNeed: Keep architecture gates; add E2E without weakening assertions.

findings.title: Stages 1-22 numbering is audit-constructed from Issue #73 AI/Ops/Mobile labels
findings.observation: Not historic PR Stage N/67 IDs. Mapping documented in step1; Step 3 statuses apply to audit IDs only.
findings.impact: Do not equate audit stage number with PR title Stage N/67 for N<=22.
